svg.title: Find products with excess stock
svg.desc: The query reads the current run and complete cutoff, calculates district-1 product demand and stock, computes nonnegative excess, and returns the ten largest excess rows. An illustrative row has 58 units, expected demand 8.1, and excess 49.9. Choose a ready row with positive excess.

text.tspan: Find excess stock across a district
Step 2 · Compare stock with expected demand at one complete business-time cutoff.
Illustrative row: 58 in stock − 8.1 expected sales = 49.9 excess units.
Choose a row with eligibility = ready and excess_units > 0 for the price comparison.
